items.name: DAU Gandhinagar Cube Open 2025

venue.name: Dhirubai Ambani Institute of Information and Communication Technology (DA-IICT), Gandhinagar
venue.address: Gandhinagar-Ahmedabad Road, Near Indroda Circle, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007

items.information:
* We won't be allowing late entry in the competition under any exceptions. Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called.
* Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations.
* Kindly bring your government-issued ID card while entering the campus.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.
* Participants must bring their own cubes.
* Check out the other tabs for more detailed information.

items.name: Alabama Crimson Cubing Fall 2025

venue.name: John England, Jr. Hall
venue.details: The competition will take place in the basement level multipurpose room. Entrances are outside facing Palmer Lake and Lakeside Dining Hall.

items.information:
**UA Students & Alumni:** After registering, send an ACT card screenshot or proof of a crimson email address to the organizers to qualify for the reduced registration fee of $15.

**Note:** Competitors under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian at all times.

![southeastcubing.org](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDI1NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9de1c0ebe62c6dc55566d579b73b3e7217ed5110/SOUTHEAST_5.png)
This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/home), and organized by Alabama Crimson Cubing, the University of Alabama's cubing club.
